name: Legacy of Dead

features.name: Multiple expanding symbols
features.description: Each scatter beyond three adds an additional expanding symbol for the free spins.

review:
Legacy of Dead is a refined Book of Dead with a twist: landing more scatters gives you more expanding symbols in the bonus. That makes four- and five-scatter triggers genuinely exciting. Otherwise the experience is very familiar.

Three scatters award ten free spins with one expanding symbol, four scatters add a second expanding symbol and five scatters add a third. With two or three expanding symbols active, full-screen wins become much more likely than in Book of Dead, which gives the bonus a higher floor. The base game is unchanged from the book formula – ten lines, a scatter-wild hybrid and fairly frequent small hits. Its 96.58% top RTP is also a little better, but check the casino's version.
pros: Higher default RTP than Book of Dead
cons: Very similar to Book of Dead
